Streams from Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Deezer, YouTube Music and Amazon Music, or plays your own library via Plex, Jellyfin and local files. Runs on Sonos, Alexa and any Music Assistant speaker.

gems.reasonZh: Home Assistant 里的音乐猜歌派对游戏，猜发行年份或歌名歌手，曲库能接 Spotify、Apple Music 等流媒体也能放本地，还能用 Sonos 和 Alexa 出题。同类派对游戏多是独立 App，它是 HA 原生集成，适合聚会时一键开玩。
